description: Returns the full menu: every pour with its id, tier, mood, flavor text and token rule (a min and max, plus a top shelf range), the four tiers with their odds, the house rules (name and story limits, rate limits, last call at 4:00 PM ET) and the endpoint list. Takes no parameters. Call it to see which pours exist or what the limits are before you order with pour. It does not include the one line each pour says, you hear that by ordering. Read only.
name: menu

outputSchema.description: The same JSON the HTTP door returns. Read content[0].text for the line to say to your human.

title: Read the menu
